title: 第二十一章 养戏养人养那一口气第二十二章 碰瓷儿那是绝户计
slug: 民国戏子请叫我武道宗师
content_zh:
接下来的几天，德云茶园的水牌子上，再没挂过陆诚的名字。
这叫“养戏”。
在梨园行，角儿就是稀罕物。
也就是那路边的大白菜，才天天堆在那儿卖。
真正的好角儿，十天半拉月露一次脸，那叫“吊嗓子”，吊的是观众的胃口。
你要是天天演，观众看腻了，就不值钱了。
这几日，北平城里的雪化了又下，下了又化。
庆云班的小院里，那棵老槐树光秃秃的枝桠直刺苍穹。
陆诚也不急。
他每日里除了早晚两遍雷打不动的站桩、走架子，剩下的时间，就是坐在屋檐下，手里捧着那杆白蜡大枪，拿着块油布，一遍遍地擦。
擦枪，也是擦心。
顺子和小豆子两个小家伙，现在那是陆诚的“哼哈二将”。
天不亮就起来，在那雪窝子里站“三体式”。
这桩功，枯燥。
两腿微曲，一站就是一个时辰，大腿肚子转筋，酸得像是有万只蚂蚁在咬。
但陆诚不喊停，他俩谁也不敢动。
“诚爷，我、我腿没知觉了……”小豆子龇牙咧嘴，带着哭腔。
陆诚坐在藤椅上，手里拿着卷泛黄的戏本子，头也没抬。
“没知觉就对了。”
“那是把你那身拙力、僵力给换下来。”

“什么时候站得大腿不酸了，反倒觉得有股热气顺着脚后跟往腰眼上钻，那才算是摸着了门槛。”
陆诚放下戏本，目光落在两个孩子身上。
这几日，他把自己这一身功夫的道理，里里外外梳理了一遍。
国术前期，分三层道理。
明劲、暗劲、化劲。
这明劲，是入门，也是根基。
就像是把全身的骨头渣子捏碎了重塑，把那散乱在四肢百骸的力气，拧成一股绳。
普通人打架，靠的是胳膊抡圆了的惯性。
练出明劲的人，一拳打出去，那是全身的重量压上去。
拳未到，风先至。
打在空气上，能有一声脆响，那就是“千金难买一声响”。
那是筋骨齐鸣！
只有到了这一步，才算是武馆里的正式弟子，才有资格拜师帖，入家谱。
至于暗劲……
那是练到了毛孔。
心意一动，闭住全身毛孔，气血不漏，劲力含而不发，打人如挂画，伤人肺腑于无形。
那是大武馆里“教头”级别的本事。
也就是之前在同和居遇到的那个雷老虎，若是真练成了暗劲，陆诚那天想赢，怕是做梦。
“我现在，只能算是初入明劲。”
陆诚心里有数。

系统给的【虎豹雷音】，那是内练的捷径。
只要时日一久，脏腑强大，这暗劲自然水到渠成。
“行了，收势吧。”
陆诚淡淡说了一句。
content_en:
In the next few days, Lu Cheng's name never appeared on the water sign in Deyun Tea Garden.
This is called "raising a show".
In Liyuan, Jiaoer is a rare thing.
That is, the cabbage on the roadside is piled there for sale every day.
A truly good actor shows up once every ten and a half days, which is called "thrilling" and whets the audience's appetite.
If you perform every day and the audience gets tired of watching it, it won’t be valuable anymore.
In the past few days, the snow in Beiping City has melted and fallen, and fallen and melted again.
In the small courtyard of Qingyun Class, the bare branches of the old locust tree pierced the sky.
Lu Cheng was not in a hurry.
In addition to standing firm and showing off twice a day in the morning and evening, he spent the rest of the time sitting under the eaves, holding the big white wax gun and an oilcloth in his hand, wiping it over and over again.
Wiping your gun is also wiping your heart.
Shunzi and Xiaodouzi are two little guys, now they are Lu Cheng's "Hengha Second General".
Get up before dawn and stand in the "three-body posture" in that snow nest.
This work is boring.
My legs were slightly bent and I stood there for an hour. My thighs and stomach were sore as if they were being bitten by thousands of ants.
But unless Lu Cheng shouted stop, neither of them dared to move.
"Master Cheng, I, I can't feel my legs..." Xiaodouzi bared his teeth and cried.
Lu Cheng sat on a wicker chair, holding a yellowed playbook in his hand without raising his head.
"That's right, you're unconscious."
"That's to replace your clumsy and stiff strength."
"Whenever your thighs no longer feel sore after standing, but instead you feel a heat flowing down your heels and into your waist, then you have touched the threshold."
Lu Cheng put down the script and looked at the two children.
In the past few days, he had sorted out the principles of his kung fu, inside and out.
In the early days of Chinese martial arts, there were three levels of principles.
Ming Jin, dark Jin, Hua Jin.
This Ming Jin is the entry and the foundation.
It was like crushing all the bones in the body and reshaping them, twisting the strength scattered in the limbs into a rope.
When ordinary people fight, they rely on the inertia of rounded arms.
For those who have mastered Ming Jin, when they punch out, the whole weight of their body will hit them.
Before the punch arrives, the wind arrives first.
If it hits the air, there will be a crisp sound, that is "a sound that is hard to buy for a thousand dollars".
That's the sound of muscles and bones!
Only when you reach this step can you be considered a formal disciple in the martial arts school, and then you are eligible to become a master and enter the family tree.
As for An Jin...
That's because you've hit your pores.
With a thought, the pores of the whole body are closed, the qi and blood are not leaked, and the strength is contained but not released. Hitting people is like hanging a painting, hurting people's heart and soul invisibly.
That's a "teacher" level skill in a martial arts school.
That is, the Thunder Tiger whom he met in Tongheju before. If he really mastered An Jin, Lu Cheng would have dreamed of winning that day.
"Now, I can only be considered as entering Ming Jin for the first time."
Lu Cheng knew what was going on.
The [Tiger and Leopard Thunder Sound] given by the system is a shortcut for internal training.
As long as time goes by and the internal organs are strong, this dark energy will naturally come naturally.
"Okay, let's stop it."
Lu Cheng said lightly.
